name: Memorial Park Pollinator Garden
description: A quarter-acre pollinator meadow planted and maintained by club volunteers, featuring native milkweed, coneflowers, and black-eyed Susans to support monarch butterflies and native bees.

name: Library Reading Garden
description: A tranquil outdoor reading nook adjacent to the Maplewood Public Library, maintained by club members with seasonal plantings and a small herb spiral.
location: Maplewood Public Library, 51 Baker St, Maplewood, NJ

name: Holiday Window Box Program
description: Each December, club volunteers plant and install evergreen window boxes for participating downtown businesses, adding festive greenery to the main street corridor.

name: Schoolyard Habitat Project
description: A partnership with Jefferson Elementary School to create a certified wildlife habitat on school grounds, including a rain garden, bird feeders, and educational signage.
